provenance.derivation: voxel-solar-wallpaper commit 86f0416983 on main (merged history; the repo has no PRs) added engine/Tuning.kt (parameter registry, clamping, rebuild revision, profiles, scaleCount, readout formatting) and engine/Swipe.kt (a gesture is worth at most one world; commit on threshold or flick), pinned by TuningTest.kt. The Kotlin/Android app cannot run in the grader sandbox, so per coordinator direction the package is graded on a faithful TypeScript port of those two pure files (TASK.md says so): the reference ports Tuning.kt and Swipe.kt line-for-line (Kotlin object -> module singleton, Map snapshot -> plain object, coerceIn -> min/max, toInt -> Math.trunc, String.format(Locale.US, %.2f) -> toFixed(2), Math.round unchanged; parameter properties are written out because Node type stripping rejects them). TASK.md restates the two Milestone 4 tasks from docs/tasks.md and the commit's parameter table and semantics, including the 1e-9/1e-12 tolerances and the flick window. The agent files are two one-line stubs (both files are new in the commit). Hidden scenarios port every TuningTest case that does not need the renderer (clamping, uniqueness/ranges, revision, unknown ids, snapshot round-trip, missing ids, all swipe cases) and add held-out values: revision counts per call, live fields, scaleCount truncation and negative bases, readout formats away from rounding ties, flick window edges, and threshold probes either side of (not at) a floating-point boundary. TuningTest's Scene/AmbientEvents cases need the renderer port and are excluded.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
